pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular, complex polygonal geometries with sharp, jagged edge gradients. The spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the dorsal neck and transitions to smaller, more fragmented shapes toward the lower shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space forms a continuous, interconnected topological graph of thin pathways. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways is narrow and consistent across the visible neck and shoulder regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a continuous 1D geometric contour with a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the blurred background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent, horizontal, light-colored (de-pigmented) linear marks are visible within the dark patches on the mid-lateral flank, indicating localized physical trauma or healed lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark, tufted tail and partial posterior section of a secondary individual are visible on the left side, partially occluding the primary subject.
